Local converter input energy storage after FB1.
Very short converter input high-frequency bypass, at U1 pins 1 and 2.
Local output bypass for U1, before the RC filter.
Input RC filter capacitor; capacitance falls with applied DC voltage, so the calculated filter corner is approximate.
Analog +5 V bulk bypass; supports enable-load steps and op-amp supply current.
Reference input bypass at U3 pin 2.
Reference output reservoir. R8 adds controlled ESR to avoid low-ESR noise peaking discussed in the REF50 data sheet.
Noise-reduction capacitor from U3 TRIM/NR pin to AGND; reduces reference noise and adds settling delay.
U4 local high-frequency supply decoupling; place by pin 4 with a short ground return to pin 11/AGND.
U4 local low-frequency/burst bypass complementing C11.
U5 local high-frequency bypass at pin 8.
U5 local reservoir, complementing C13 and the common +5VA bulk capacitor.
Voltage-command ramp capacitor. Q3 discharges it when K2 commands off; startup ramp occurs when Q3 releases.
Output RF shunt after R13. This is not an HV filter capacitor.
Filters current-command noise ahead of U4D without capacitively loading the op-amp output.
Output RF bypass for current program, after R19.
Shunts monitor RF pickup at the U5A non-inverting input.
Current-monitor input RF filter capacitor at U5B.

values.Rating: 15 V standoff, 400 W specified pulse, SMA

Flywheel diode across the parallel relay coils (cathode at +12V). Prevents an inductive spike at Q2; it lengthens release time, which must be measured.
Regulator reverse-discharge diode: anode at +5VA, cathode at LDO_IN. Diverts stored output-capacitor charge if input collapses.
Indicates protected 12 V input power. Does not indicate HV discharge.
Indicates relay-coil drive, not measured accelerating voltage. Cathode follows the coil driver collector.

values.Rating: 12 V / 288 ohm coil, 41.7 mA nominal; 2 A at 30 V DC resistive
values.Function: 12 V DPDT relay: contact 4-8 switches module input power; contact 13-9 seals in the ARM request. Contacts 4-6 and 13-11 are normally closed and unused.

values.Rating: Functional relay; no force-guided contacts or safety integrity rating claimed
values.Function: 12 V DPDT relay: deenergized contact 4-6 grounds enable, energized 4-8 applies limited +5VA. Contact 13 drives both command clamps high when off (11) and low when running (9). Coil is in PGND domain; contacts are in AGND domain.
P-channel reverse-input protection. Drain faces the fused input and source faces +12V; the body diode initially charges the bus, then the channel bypasses it. Tab is drain.
Saturated low-side relay driver. Pin 1 base, pin 2 emitter, pin 3 collector. Switches both 41.7 mA coils without requiring the button to carry coil current.

values.Rating: 60 V N-MOSFET, SOT-23; gate 1, source 2, drain 3
values.Function: Clamps V_RAMP near AGND when CMD_CLAMP is high. R12 limits steady clamp current below 0.41 mA; releases for the RC ramp when armed. Keeps voltage program near zero with module input power off.

values.Rating: 60 V N-MOSFET, SOT-23; gate 1, source 2, drain 3
values.Function: Clamps I_RAMP near AGND while disabled, avoiding a standing current-program voltage into an unpowered module. R18 limits clamp current below 0.14 mA. Verify leakage-induced setpoint error on hardware.
Pulls Q1 gate toward power return to turn on correctly polarized input power.
Limits Q2 base current to roughly 11 mA at 12 V. The 1206 quarter-watt package accommodates about 0.154 W at 13.2 V.
Discharges Q2 base and holds the relay driver off with an open permit/button circuit.
Sets green power LED current to about 2.1 mA.
Sets red command LED current to approximately 4.4 mA when Q2 conducts.
Limits enable-drive current into the mandatory external 330 ohm pull-down; about 3.84 V enable and 11.6 mA load nominal.
Together with C6, filters converter switching ripple and limits charging current. Nominal 22 ohm / 10 uF corner is 723 Hz, before MLCC DC-bias effects.
Adds 1.2 ohm series ESR only in C9's capacitor branch, not in the DC reference output path; target total ESR 1-1.5 ohm.
Fixed top-leg resistance prevents the maximum-voltage trim from reaching the full 4.096 V reference.
Bottom leg of voltage-ceiling divider; U4A prevents the user voltage control from loading this divider.
Pulls the voltage wiper toward zero if wiper contact opens; introduces at most about 0.25% mid-travel loading.
Voltage-command slew/noise filter with C15: nominal time constant 100 ms, roughly 0.5 s to settle. Source resistance and capacitor bias modify this.
Isolates U4B from cable/C16 capacitance. Together with external and module input resistance causes about 1.2% attenuation, included in calibration.
Local voltage-program pull-down; the separate module-side 10 kohm termination is still required for an unplugged harness.
Upper current-ceiling divider resistor; with R16 generates 4.096/3 = 1.36533 V.
Lower current-ceiling divider resistor. U4C isolates this ratio from RV2 loading.
Pulls an open current-control wiper toward zero current command.
Current-command low-pass filter with C17, nominal 10 ms time constant.
Isolates U4D from C18/cable capacitance; includes about 1.3% loaded attenuation with the conservative module input impedance.
Local current-program pull-down, supplementing the mandatory module-side 10 kohm resistor.
Voltage-monitor input filter resistance. With the module's source impedance and C19, corner lies roughly between 145 Hz and 1.59 kHz.
High-value monitor input pull-down; worst source-loading error is about 0.11%. A zero reading after unplugging is not evidence that HV has discharged.
Current-monitor input filter resistor; does not measure picoampere specimen current.
Discharges a disconnected current-monitor filter with about a one-second RC decay; minimizes loading while giving a defined eventual state.
Voltage-monitor output cable isolation resistor. Use a meter/input of at least 1 Mohm; 10 Mohm is preferred.
Current-monitor output cable isolation resistor; keep external capacitive load small and verify buffer stability.
5 mA preload makes the unregulated converter's light-load operating point more predictable; dissipates only 25 mW.
Defaults both command-clamp gates high during relay transition/open contact. K2 actively grounds this net only while energized.

values.Name: Electrostatic scan plates
values.Notes: Ideal parallel electrostatic plates generate E=V/g. Selected DAC80502 scan module provides low-voltage X/Y commands; external differential scan amplifiers remain separate, with gain100 modeled but hardware not selected. Plate geometry, fringing and amplifier settling need measurement.

values.Name: Chamber / roughing and turbopumps
values.Notes: Effective speeds, chamber volume, conductance and base pressures are illustrative; choose pumps and gauges for actual gas load and plumbing.

values.Name: LMC662 specimen-current amplifier + ADS1115 PCB
values.Notes: User-selected specimen-current prototype. Stage inside vacuum must be electrically insulated from the grounded chamber and conductive to the sample. J1 connects through a short shielded vacuum feedthrough to the external guarded PCB. U1A LMC662 ±5 V; 100 MΩ || 10 pF. U1B attenuates/inverts by 10k/40.2k with 1.32 V reference. ADS1115 A0-A1 differential, zero/gain calibration mandatory. Default ±0.256 V and 128 SPS. No separate detector HV. Noise floor and sample yields are assumptions; PCB is unbuilt. See /current.html and detector-pcb/. Legacy BSE/ET values retained only for comparison modes.

values.Name: ESP32 scan controller / ADS1115 acquisition
values.Notes: Classic ESP32: DAC80502 SCLK18/SDIN23/SYNC27; GPIO26 unused (software LDAC). GPIO25 blank request. ADS1115 SDA21/SCL22; leave ALERT disconnected. Fresh single-shot conversions after beam-on settling; z zero calibration then s start; x stops/blanks. USB power ESP32 separately; detector REF3V3 is not ESP32 power. New DAC80502 scan module needs clean 3.3 V and its own buffered 1.25 V center.

values.Name: LMC662 feedback resistor
values.Notes: Rev A fitted 100M 1%. Changing this model value represents replacing the physical part. Physical BOM changes invalidate this review and require matching the numerical parameter before starting a new BOM run. Board CAD/fabrication outputs remain the reviewed Rev A; regenerate and recheck them after hardware edits.

values.Name: LMC662 feedback capacitor
values.Notes: Rev A fitted 10p C0G. Changing this model value represents replacing the physical part. Physical BOM changes invalidate this review and require matching the numerical parameter before starting a new BOM run. Board CAD/fabrication outputs remain the reviewed Rev A; regenerate and recheck them after hardware edits.

values.Name: DAC80502 precision X/Y scan module
values.Notes: Selected dual 16-bit DAC. Module VDD 3.3 V, internal 2.5 V reference; GAIN = 0x0103 divides the reference by 2 and uses buffer gain 2, giving nominal 0–2.5 V outputs. SPI mode 1, 24-bit writes, 1 MHz; paired software LDAC. Buffered 1.25 V center feeds external differential scan amplifiers. Amplifier gain 100 is a model assumption, not a selected driver. Nominal step is not measured spatial resolution; bench offset, gain, noise and settling remain unverified. Native PCB in scan-dac-pcb/.
